results.name: Every screen renders in KO and EN for every role in the real browser with no error text, no undefined/NaN and no console errors
Floating status board: filters change the numbers; impossible combination shows an empty state
Top-up simulator inside the hotel credit card computes instantly, labels itself a simulation, writes nothing and does not carry an amount over to another contract
CSV upload: validate (dry-run) → commit only accepted rows → re-commit adds nothing; duplicates and bad rows are reported
Role switch disables write controls for VIEWER and CEO, enables them for SCM
Refresh consistency: a posted transaction, confirmation and score survive a browser reload with identical numbers
Approval-packet flow in the UI: draft → request CEO review → CEO sends feedback (required); SCM cannot review; the person in charge sees the feedback; ledger never changes
XSS: hostile text posted through the UI is rendered inert (no element injected, no script run)
Print / file output: print stylesheet hides chrome; the approval packet screen offers print and JSON export
Responsive: desktop row layout, tablet (800px) stacked layout with no page-level horizontal overflow
Tables sort by header and search by text
Corrupt storage: app starts from the sample, warns the user, and keeps the unreadable blob
Legacy partner module still loads, evaluates 12 partners (one of them scores 78.7, grade B) and keeps its own storage key; new app does not share it
Language toggle switches visible text and persists across reload
Administration: invalid weights rejected with message; valid change needs a reason and appears in change history
Risk center: severity filter, status update with note, dismissal blocked for SCM, history lists cleared alerts
Hotel profile: scores cannot be typed in; recording evidence recalculates grade, score and confidence; a record without evidence is refused; commit needs a reason and is shown in history
Accessibility basics: every form control has an accessible name; landmarks, lang and live region exist
Render performance: dashboard and profile re-render in < 300 ms
Japanese and Vietnamese: toggle, persistence after reload, per-language font, all 8 screens without leftover Korean labels or missing-translation fallbacks
ELLIS snapshot panel: sample → preview changes nothing → import stores aggregates only → comparison shows divergence; viewer is locked out; bad input is explained
Landing page: deep link goes to the login first, language can be chosen there, wrong password is refused, the account fixes the role, sign-out and expiry end the session
Permission table in Administration: roles as columns, the current role highlighted, only the CEO column can approve
Tracker check panel (preview only), top-up terms on the credit card, offset in the ledger form, and the ELLIS comparison on the net basis

Dashboard in country cards: one card per country with one currency, six lines each, every line opens the screen where the number is worked on with that country already chosen; the hotel credit profile has a country filter
Hotel-level cap in the credit card: SCM enters an amount and a reason, the limit in force drops, the status board shows it, SCM cannot raise it, the CEO lifts it, and a reader sees disabled controls
Credit card: every criterion shows its computed score, the reason and what would raise it; the administrator changes the country table and the score follows
Dashboard by legal entity: the Singapore head office holds the moved contracts in seven currencies, the local entities keep the rest, and a card opens the status board for that entity
Hotel credit card in nine sections: the ELLIS booking speed next to the ledger, the next top-up date, the cooperation opinion and the next check date
